entities.name: Jarsyl
entities.description: A powerful wizard from Dominaria at the start of the Dark Age, one of the first students of the Conclave of Mages, who vanished through a portal to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Harbin
entities.description: Jarsyl's father, presumed killed in the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: Jarsyl's grandmother who raised him in Penregon.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Possible grandfather of Jarsyl; avoided him as a planeswalker.

entities.name: Barl
entities.description: Interviewed Jodah and had never heard of Jarsyl.

entities.name: Melana
entities.description: Jarsyl's mother, who established the farmstead with his tower.

entities.name: Ratepe
entities.description: Read stories copied from Jarsyl's journal.

entities.name: Conclave of Mages
entities.description: School and refuge for mages near Ronom Lake.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Metal plane Jarsyl reached through a portal.

events.summary: Jarsyl leaves his grandmother and joins the Conclave of Mages as one of its first students.
events.quote: He left his grandmother Kayla and joined the Conclave of Mages

events.summary: Jarsyl discovers a portal to Phyrexia and writes of what he saw there.
events.quote: Jarsyl later discovered a planar portal to the plane of Phyrexia

events.summary: Jarsyl reproduces the portal spell with black mana and disappears from Dominaria, never seen again.
events.quote: he disappeared from Dominaria and was never seen again

events.summary: Jodah figures out the portal spell but uses white mana, so it fails; he later learns it needs black mana and never completes it.
events.quote: but mistakenly used white mana instead of black, causing the spell to fail

relations.quote: Jarsyl was the son of Harbin
He was the great-great-grandfather of Jodah .
became one of its first students
